title: helm(private): tighten values schema + init hooks + upgrade/rollback helpers for private installer
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: Helm chart for Redwood Private has accumulated ad-hoc values and init jobs that make upgrades fragile for on-prem/VPC installs. This PR tightens the values schema (with validation), consolidates init-hook jobs for migrations and CRD bootstrapping, and adds explicit pre-upgrade and rollback helpers (helm hooks + templating) to make upgrades safer.

What changed (summary):
- values.schema.json: stricter schema for private.values (networking, storage, k8s/runtime settings, kms, and certificates). Adds deprecation warnings for old fields and clear examples for single-tenant VPC and multi-tenant modes.
- templates/init-jobs/: consolidated init jobs (init-crds, init-db, init-secrets) and made them idempotent via leader-election annotation and checks. Jobs are annotated as "helm.sh/hook": pre-install,pre-upgrade.
- templates/pre-upgrade-hook.yaml: new Job that snapshots PVC volumes (using restic integration when enabled) and exports critical configmaps to a stable backup location. This runs as pre-upgrade to protect stateful components.
- templates/rollback-hook.yaml: on failure, a post-upgrade hook can run to restore backed-up configmaps and trigger db rollback scripts (when enabled via values.rollback.enable).
- _helpers.tpl and NOTES.txt: added upgrade/rollback guidance and recommended helm command sequences (dry-run, --atomic, known-good image pinning).
- Chart.yaml and README: bumped chart minor version and documented the schema changes and upgrade plan.

Testing done:
- Unit: schema validation tests for values.json and chart template rendering for common permutations (single-tenant VPC, multi-az, on-prem).
- Integration: upgraded a staging Redwood Private cluster from v1.6.2 -> this branch with pre-upgrade snapshot enabled; validated KV cache, database connectivity, and CRD versions.
- E2E: run upgrade/rollback scenario in perf-canary infra with synthetic traffic; verified successful rollback when post-upgrade health checks fail.

Migration / Rollout notes:
- Operators should run: helm upgrade --install redwood-private . --values values.yaml --history-max 10 --atomic --wait 
- If using PVC snapshotting, enable values.preUpgrade.snapshot.enabled=true and ensure restic credentials configured.
- Backward-incompatible fields are guarded with deprecation warnings; follow README mapping to migrate values.

Checklist:
- [x] Schema validation added and tests updated
- [x] Init jobs consolidated and idempotent
- [x] Pre-upgrade snapshot/backup job implemented
- [x] Rollback helper implemented and tested in staging
- [x] Docs and NOTES updated

Related: Linear ENG-2314 (private installer upgrade UX), ENG-2378 (helm init-job flakiness).

review_conversation: Connor Wu (reviewer): Can we make the pre-upgrade snapshot optional? We don't want to mandate restic for small installs.
Aisha Patel (author): Yes — it's gated behind values.preUpgrade.snapshot.enabled and defaults to false. Added docs about prerequisites.
Marina Kovacs (reviewer): init-db job previously failed intermittently under high load. Did you add any backoff/retry?
Aisha Patel (author): Added leader-election annotation and a readiness check for dependent CRDs; job now retries on transient DB connection errors and uses backoffLimit=5.
Diego Martinez (reviewer): schema change may break some enterprise customers. Recommend adding migration notes to README and an automated values-mapper script.

Aisha Patel (author): Added deprecation mapping and example values-mapper script (small helper) in README; opted not to include script in chart to keep chart minimal — we provide it in redwood-private-installer repo.
CI: pipeline passed after rerun — addressed lint failures by reformatting templates.
Connor Wu (approver): LGTM pending green CI
Marina Kovacs (approver): Approved — tested upgrade in staging cluster
release_notes: Improve Helm chart upgrade safety for Redwood Private: stricter values schema, idempotent init jobs, optional pre-upgrade PVC snapshotting, and rollback helpers. Operators should review README for migration steps.
